text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: 1st place, Mihono Bourbon—!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Mihono Bourbon really is incredible!
She might actually pull off the Triple Crown at this rate!?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: You were the best, Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Mission complete.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The next target is the Japan Derby. Commencing the plan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(Amazing... It's like
flowers have bloomed all across the stands!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...As expected of Bourbon-san.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Man, that was totally lacklustre!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I should have given it everything I had,
and yet, somehow..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: True, Mihono Bourbon completely stole the show in this Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Classic Triple Crown route...
Every competitor is a fierce contender. Indeed...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well, we start from here! We might have missed the Triple Crown, but it's not over yet.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Racing up close with Bourbon-san,
I kind of got a sense of her racing quirks.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's why... it's okay!
We definitely have a shot at winning the Nihon Derby!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't reach them...
Rice just isn't strong enough at all right now...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...*sniffle*!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...If I stay like this, nothing will change...!
Before the Japanese Derby, I have to get stronger, much, much stronger...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I've gotta give it my all...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Rice-san...
She had such a determined look in her eyes."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it, in today's Satsuki Sho, Bourbon-san was amazing, but Rice-san was also, how should I put it—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It had this unique intensity to it...!
Like, whooooah, whoa-choooo... kind of vibe!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I bet she'll push even harder
in the Nippon Derby and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Now we really can't let our guard down.
All right, I'm gonna give it my all~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And that is why, Trainer!
Let's go eat some ramen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Because I was hungry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, while slurping shio ramen
at a randomly chosen noodle shop—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Excuse meee!
Another noodle refill, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fired up once again for the upcoming Nippon Derby!
